description: Stereo screen of a 220 Hz sawtooth under delay, decorrelation, unison, chorus and reverb.
name: 47-stereo-screen

recipe.channel_scaling: none; rows compare the raw channels
recipe.ipd_deg: 8192-point centred Hann STFT, hop 2048; per frame, at the bin of the largest |L conj R| within 2 bins of h f0 for h = 1..20, abs(angle(L conj R)) in degrees, averaged with weights |L conj R|; then the mean over frames whose mid RMS is within 40 dB of the loudest
recipe.rho: Pearson correlation of L and R at zero lag

rows.chorus: each channel is saw + saw delayed by 7 ms + 2 ms sin(2 pi 0.8 t + phi), phi = 0 on L and pi on R, per harmonic phase
rows.delay_0_4_ms: R is L delayed by 0.4 ms, exactly, per harmonic phase
rows.haas_10_ms: R is L delayed by 10 ms, exactly, per harmonic phase
rows.reverb: each channel is (1 - wet) saw + wet (saw convolved with its own unit-energy noise reverb of RT60 1 s and 1.5 s length, seeds 4730 for L and 4731 for R)
rows.unison: voices detuned evenly across -25 to +25 cents, phase 2 pi uniform(4720 + v, 1) for voice v; voices alternate left and right with rank, pan p = width * rank / max rank, constant-power gains L = cos(pi/4 (1 + p)), R = sin(pi/4 (1 + p))
rows.velvet_20_ms: each channel is the saw convolved with its own velvet noise: one impulse per 1 ms cell over 20 ms at a uniform position, sign + or - with equal odds; L draws uniform(4710, 40), R uniform(4711, 40): position then sign per cell

recipe.sm_db: 20 log10(rms(S) / rms(M)), M = (L + R) / 2, S = (L - R) / 2; None when either RMS is 0
recipe.source: band-limited sawtooth: harmonic h at amplitude 1/h below the Nyquist frequency, phase 0

rounding: the issue prints rho to three decimals, dB to one and degrees to one
tolerance_note: 10 % or 2 degrees, whichever is larger, as the issue states
